job.rawJd:
JOB DESCRIPTION OVERVIEW 
CREO’s AI Enablement practice helps life sciences, healthcare, and technology organizations unlock the value of AI through strategy, governance, adoption change management, and hands-on training. As a Consultant on this team, you will own client engagements end to end — leading teams to stand up AI Champions programs, launch workshop series, operationalize governance frameworks, and drive measurable adoption at scale. 
This role blends deep AI Enablement expertise with the autonomy, leadership, and accountability of a seasoned consultant. You will serve as a trusted advisor to client-side Chief AI Officers, or those delegated to lead AI, and their champion communities, mentor junior staff, shape delivery strategy, and actively grow the offering through business development. You live the CREO values, and you are always learning and always teaching. 
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES 
Lead and Deliver AI Enablement Engagements 
You will own client AI programs across the full lifecycle — from discovery and planning through delivery, adoption, and ongoing program leadership. 

- Lead and manage client engagements focused on AI readiness assessments, governance frameworks, champion programs, workshop series, and use-case discovery, with significant autonomy over scope, approach, and outcomes. 


- Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI enablement projects, from initial assessment and requirements gathering through implementation, adoption, and post-deployment support. 


- Direct discovery and working sessions to identify and assess AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, risk, and adoption readiness, translating client pain points into practical opportunities such as chatbots, workflow automations, knowledge management tools, and analytics assistants. 


- Manage multiple concurrent workstreams and engagement teams, tracking scope, schedule, deliverables, risks, and action items, and serving as the delegated Project Manager where required. 


- Act as a trusted advisor and right hand to client-side AI leaders, program leads, and champion communities — driving decisions, capturing outcomes, and sustaining momentum between sessions. 


- Collaborate with AI engineers and solution architects to translate technical work into narratives that land with executives and end users, and partner with clients and technical teams to deploy specialized AI or machine learning tools into client environments when needed. 


- Support AI solutions in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments by documenting requirements, risks, controls, and user guidance to the quality standard clients expect. 


- Mentor and develop junior staff, ensuring engagements meet client expectations, are completed on time, and align with industry best practices and emerging technologies. 


- Maintain personal billable utilization at the rate of 1700 hours per year. 

Develop AI-Focused Client Deliverables 
You will produce polished, insight-rich artifacts that make complex AI concepts accessible and actionable for client leadership and end users. 

- Build client-ready PowerPoint decks, workshop materials, playbooks, and written reports that communicate complex AI concepts clearly and compellingly to non-technical audiences. 


- Develop AI strategy documents, adoption roadmaps, solution architectures, and financial models that articulate business value and demonstrate measurable impact. 


- Produce governance artifacts including AI solution intake forms, risk models, use-case inventories, and executive-ready status reports with strong attention to quality and client-readiness. 


- Develop and maintain enablement assets such as dashboards, SharePoint sites, training repositories, champion community hubs, prompt libraries, and intranet content that sustain adoption after each engagement. 

Facilitate AI Upskilling, Training, and Champion Programs 
You will help non-technical users understand, adopt, and get lasting value from AI tools and solutions. 

- Design and facilitate CREO’s AI Foundations workshops, champion kick-offs, hands-on labs, case contests, and recurring office hours for client teams. 


- Lead AI adoption change management — internal comms, awareness campaigns, and community-building — that turns pilots into organization-wide deployments. 


- Coordinate training logistics and attendee experience across in-person and remote modalities, ensuring every session translates into adoptable use cases. 


- Package lessons learned, reusable templates, and engagement materials into scalable assets for future CREO AI Enablement work. 

Drive AI Tool Fluency — Always Learning, Always Teaching 
AI is moving fast. You will be expected to stay current and bring what you learn back to clients and colleagues. 

- Continuously evaluate new AI tools, platforms, and agent frameworks, staying current on emerging capabilities relevant to client work. 


- Actively use AI in your own daily work — drafting, summarization, research, deck development, and analysis — demonstrating practical value through what you produce. 


- Share what you learn through internal knowledge shares, client office hours, and champion enablement sessions, helping the rest of the CREO team and our clients get sharper, faster. 

Contribute to Business Development 
You will help grow the AI Enablement offering and position CREO as a trusted partner and thought leader. 

- Achieve an annual sales target, as communicated separately. 


- Identify AI-driven opportunities within existing client relationships and help acquire new clients, conducting AI readiness assessments and preparing proposals for enablement engagements. 


- Foster relationships with senior executives and champion communities, influencing decision-makers to drive revenue growth and expand CREO’s AI consulting offerings. 
 

Communicate with Clarity and Executive Presence 
Strong communication is non-negotiable. You will regularly translate complex work for non-technical audiences and sustain momentum across client teams. 

- Record and summarize technical and executive discussions during client and internal meetings, ensuring decisions and action items are captured and circulated to the right stakeholders. 

- 
- Translate stakeholder interviews, use-case discovery sessions, and workshop outputs into structured written artifacts the client can act on. 
- 
- Communicate clearly, concisely, and confidently in both written and verbal form across technical and non-technical audiences, up to and including executive leadership. 
- Exhibit communication and collaboration best practices including which tool when and adjusting messaging to the audience. 

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 

We hire for expertise, leadership, and the drive to bring others along. If you meet most of these qualifications and are excited about this work, we encourage you to apply. 
 

- 5+ years of consulting experience or equivalent work experience, including leading engagements and mentoring junior staff. 


- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; master’s or equivalent post-graduate degree (or in process) preferred. 


- Proven ability to design and deliver AI-enabled solutions — tools, automations, chatbots, workflow assistants, analytics tools, or internal productivity applications — that drive adoption and business value. 


- Demonstrated leadership managing project teams and client engagements with significant autonomy and accountability for outcomes. 


- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; attention to detail; able to explain AI concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and present to senior-level stakeholders without sacrificing accuracy. 


- Advanced expertise in PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook, with a portfolio of polished, client-ready deliverables, models, roadmaps, and presentations. 


- Deep working fluency with the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Planner, OneNote). 


- Hands-on experience with generative AI tools (Copilot, Azure Foundry, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and a genuine desire to adopt and teach new AI tools as they emerge. 


- Experience working with cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure and AWS to support AI application deployment, user management, provisioning, and automation tasks. 


- Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams on tight deadlines with shifting priorities. 


- Experience contributing to business development, including proposal writing, client relationship management, and identifying new service opportunities. 


- Commitment to CREO’s core values and making a meaningful difference in the world. 
 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in Project, program or change management; PMP or Prosci (in progress or completed) a plus. 


- Experience leading or delivering technical training, or within a Learning and Development function or practice. 


- Experience designing, leading, or facilitating training workshops or enablement programs. 


- Exposure to life sciences, biotech, healthcare, or other regulated industries. 


- Experience with or knowledge of AI or machine learning tools such as AlphaFold, Chai-1, language models, and NLP workflows. 


- Hands-on experience building SharePoint sites, Power Apps, or Power Automate flows. 


- Familiarity with AI governance concepts: responsible AI, risk frameworks, and enterprise AI policies. 

- 
- Experience supporting champion communities, internal enablement groups, or AI adoption programs. 
- 
- Relevant AI certifications such as Generative AI for Everyone (DeepLearning.AI), Microsoft AI Fundamentals, etc. 
​​​​​Please note: This application may be reviewed in part by automated systems to help identify qualified candidates.​​​​​​​

paragraphs: I am applying for the CREO AI Enablement Consultant role because it brings together the work I have been building toward across healthcare client leadership, enterprise UX, and hands-on AI delivery. I know how to take an unclear business problem, run the discovery, shape a practical workflow, and give people something they can test and use. That is the thread connecting my account, product, research, and AI work.

At Hedgehox, I turn recurring pharma agency problems into AI tools for claim review, brief intake, scoping, review routing, submission capture, and regulatory monitoring. I built the functional Claims Detector POC, shaped the demo with investors, and secured an investor. The workflow identifies promotional claims, surfaces evidence gaps, and prepares audit-ready annotations for human review before MLR submission. It is practical AI built around the standards and judgment regulated teams already need.

My enablement experience comes from building the systems that help teams adopt a new way of working. At Kinesso, I built the first UX research practice across more than 20 products, led workshops on discovery and ecosystem mapping, and expanded that program to other IPG groups. I also helped grow a distributed design team from 2 to 30 and created onboarding, coaching, and performance-review systems with the Head of Design. The products supported more than 7,000 people across 22 brands, so the work had to be clear, repeatable, and useful after the workshop ended.

Earlier, I spent eight years managing Fortune 500 healthcare clients and brand budgets up to $20M. That taught me how to run difficult conversations, translate between specialists and executives, keep regulated work moving, and make the next decision clear. Through One Block Away, I now apply that same discipline to client-led AI POCs built with Claude Code and Codex. I would welcome the chance to discuss how this mix could help CREO lead practical AI enablement programs for healthcare and life sciences clients.

resume.summary: AI enablement and implementation lead with 15 years across healthcare client leadership, enterprise UX, and regulated AI workflows. I lead discovery, workshops, and delivery from an unclear business need to a working POC, practical guidance, and stakeholder adoption. Recent work includes governed LLM and VLM review tools, client-led AI workflows, and enterprise products used by 7,000+ people across 22 brands.
